From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@orionai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery + quick question on next step

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery: 

- Goal: Reduce inference cost for your summarization pipeline and cut 95th percentile latency under 180ms for peak traffic.
- Current infra: 4x p2-style GPUs in-house + queued batching; KV cache not implemented yet.
- Success metric: <20% cost uplift for same output quality; pilot with 10M tokens/month target.
- Constraints: SSO + strict key management (KMS/HSM) and SOC2 evidence required for procurement.

Attached is a short one-page recap (discovery highlights + suggested next steps). Two options I suggested on the call:

1) 4-week pilot on Redwood Dedicated (predictable throughput, isolated tenant) — we'll help scope a micro-workload and provide a pilot plan + SLO targets;
2) 30-min technical Q&A with Monica (our solutions engineer) to walk your infra constraints and integration approach (SSO, KMS).

My question: which of these is most useful for you right now — pilot or a quick technical session? If pilot, we can draft an initial mutual action plan and propose dates; if Q&A, how's next week look (Tue/Wed afternoon PT)?

Thanks — and if your priority has shifted, let me know so we don't bug you.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: 20280223-discovery-recap.pdf (1 page PDF, summary bullets)

Hi Alex —

Just circling back on the note below. Haven't heard back and wanted to check if this is still a priority on your roadmap for Q2. 

If helpful, we can:
- Schedule a 20–30 min tech Q&A (Monica) to answer KMS/SSO questions; or
- Draft a short pilot scope you can share with procurement (timeline + deliverables).

I can be flexible on timing — happy to block 15 minutes for a quick alignment call. Any updates on timeframe?

Cheers,
Sean

Thanks, Sean — apologies for the slow reply. We had a short internal pause while budgets were finalized. We're still interested; pilot sounds like the right next move but I want to make sure the KMS/SSO path is doable.

Can we do the technical Q&A first so Monica can walk through SSO and where keys would live? I can do Tue 14 Mar 11:00–11:30 PT or Wed 15 Mar 15:00–15:30 PT. If Monica has a preference, loop her in and we'll lock a slot.
